name: bofa-jithub
//: Thin orchestrator for deploy platforms that build from the repo root (Railway).
It owns NO dependencies on purpose: every dep the backend needs is declared in
react-webapp/backend/package.json. Deps used to be duplicated here with DIFFERENT
versions (e.g. @clerk/backend ^3 here vs ^2 in the backend) — the backend's copy
always won at resolution, so the root copies were dead weight that could only
cause confusion. The frontend is deployed separately by Vercel with its Root
Directory set to react-webapp/frontend and never builds from here.
